explanation: Previous phases reported hundreds of Python lines using Python `.splitlines()`, but GitHub raw still renders key files as a few huge physical lines. This strongly indicates non-LF line endings, likely CR-only. Python may compile CR-only files, but GitHub/raw/review tooling does not treat them as normal LF-delimited source files. Therefore, byte-level LF count is the new acceptance criterion, and CR-only/CRLF are strictly forbidden.
